# libserialport in KVMux

- Version: 0.1.2
- Commit: `bc8f88ef3399b76da7992a99badebada419d0e19`
- Source: https://github.com/sigrokproject/libserialport/archive/bc8f88ef3399b76da7992a99badebada419d0e19.tar.gz

Retained files are the public/internal headers, common serial/timing sources, the
Windows, Linux and macOS platform sources, upstream README/authors and license.
KVMux adds only a CMake target and compile-time feature detection; upstream
source files are unchanged.
